messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a list of the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a public holiday that falls on a weekday (Monday–Thursday) and therefore gives you at least three consecutive days off (including the weekend).  

| Date | Day | Holiday | Notes |
|------|-----|---------|-------|
| **January 1** | Sunday | New Year’s Day | (Weekend) |
| **January 2** | Monday | New Year’s Day (Observed) | Observed because Jan 1 was a Sunday |
| **February 20** | Monday | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Observed in those provinces |
| **March 17** | Friday | St. Patrick’s Day (Ontario) | Observed in Ontario |
| **April 7** | Monday | Good Friday | (Federal & most provinces) |
| **April 10** | Thursday | Easter Monday (Quebec, Ontario, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island, Nova Scotia, Newfoundland & Labrador) | Observed in those provinces |
| **May 22** | Monday | Victoria Day | (Federal & most provinces) |
| **June 19** | Monday | Canada Day | (Federal & most provinces) |
| **July 1** | Saturday | Canada Day (Weekend) | (Weekend) |
| **July 3** | Monday | Canada Day (Observed) | Observed because July 1 was a Saturday |
| **September 18** | Monday | Labour Day | (Federal & most provinces) |
| **October 9** | Monday | Thanksgiving Day | (Federal & most provinces) |
| **November 7** | Monday | Remembrance Day (observed in some provinces) | Observed in Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, Quebec, Saskatchewan, Yukon |
| **December 25** | Monday | Christmas Day | (Federal & most provinces) |
| **December 26** | Tuesday | Boxing Day | (Federal & most provinces) |

### Long‑Weekend Summary (2023)

| Long Weekend | Dates Covered | Total Days Off |
|--------------|---------------|----------------|
| New Year’s (Observed) | Jan 1–Jan 3 | 3 |
| Family Day | Feb 18–Feb 20 | 3 |
| St. Patrick’s Day | Mar 15–Mar 17 | 3 |
| Good Friday | Apr 7–Apr 9 | 3 |
| Easter Monday | Apr 8–Apr 10 | 3 |
| Victoria Day | May 20–May 22 | 3 |
| Canada Day (Observed) | Jun 17–Jun 19 | 3 |
| Labour Day | Sep 16–Sep 18 | 3 |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 7–Oct 9 | 3 |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 5–Nov 7 | 3 |
| Christmas | Dec 23–Dec 25 | 3 |
| Boxing Day | Dec 24–Dec 26 | 3 |

> **Note:** Some holidays are province‑specific. The table above lists the federal holidays and those observed in the majority of provinces. If you need province‑specific details (e.g., Family Day only in certain provinces), let me know which provinces you’re interested in.

Feel free to copy this data into your holiday‑planning app!
